title: Term explorer
description: How often terms are mentioned in a group or subreddits, relative to all comments and posts.

list.name: group
list.label: Group
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT group_name FROM subreddit_groups ORDER BY group_name = 'tracked' DESC, group_name
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT group_name FROM subreddit_groups ORDER BY group_name = 'tracked' DESC, group_name

list.name: subreddit
list.label: Subreddits
list.query: SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} ORDER BY subreddit
list.definition: SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring} ORDER BY subreddit

panels.title: Share of comments and posts mentioning the term (per 1,000)
panels.description: Comments and posts that contain the term, per 1,000 comments and posts in the selected subreddits. Dividing by the total removes the daily and weekly activity swings, so the line shows the share of the conversation. Separate several terms with commas. Bucket: week sums whole ISO weeks (Monday to Sunday, UTC), as the long-term trends do; days and weeks reach back further than hours (180 days). Group rate: pooled divides all mentions by all comments and posts; macro averages each subreddit's share, so a big subreddit doesn't drown out the small ones (the long-term trends of groups use it).

targets.rawSql:
WITH totals AS (
    SELECT multiIf(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'week', toDateTime(toMonday(hour), 'UTC'), ${bucket:sqlstring} = 'day', toStartOfDay(hour), ${bucket:sqlstring} = 'hour', hour, $__timeInterval(hour)) AS time, subreddit, sum(docs) AS n
    FROM scope_hourly
    WHERE if(${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week'), hour >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime) AND hour < toStartOfDay($__toTime) + INTERVAL 1 DAY, $__timeFilter(hour)) AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(subreddit IN (${subreddit:singlequote}), $subreddit) AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, subreddit
)
SELECT t.time AS time, t.term AS term,
       if(${rate:sqlstring} = 'macro', 1000 * t.share_sum / s.members, 1000 * t.docs / s.n)
           AS per_1000
FROM (
    SELECT time, term, sum(c.docs) AS docs, sum(c.docs / totals.n) AS share_sum
    FROM (
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'hour', hour, $__timeInterval(hour)) AS time, subreddit, term, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM term_hourly
    WHERE NOT ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND $__timeFilter(hour) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(subreddit IN (${subreddit:singlequote}), $subreddit) AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, subreddit, term
    UNION ALL
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'week', toDateTime(toMonday(day), 'UTC'), toDateTime(day, 'UTC')) AS time, subreddit, term, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM term_daily
    WHERE ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(subreddit IN (${subreddit:singlequote}), $subreddit) AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, subreddit, term
    ) AS c
    INNER JOIN totals USING (time, subreddit)
    GROUP BY time, term
) AS t
INNER JOIN (SELECT time, sum(n) AS n, count() AS members FROM totals GROUP BY time) AS s
    USING time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Mentions
panels.description: Comments and posts containing the term (each counts once).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, term, sum(docs) AS mentions
FROM (
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'hour', hour, $__timeInterval(hour)) AS time, subreddit, term, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM term_hourly
    WHERE NOT ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND $__timeFilter(hour) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(subreddit IN (${subreddit:singlequote}), $subreddit) AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, subreddit, term
    UNION ALL
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'week', toDateTime(toMonday(day), 'UTC'), toDateTime(day, 'UTC')) AS time, subreddit, term, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM term_daily
    WHERE ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(subreddit IN (${subreddit:singlequote}), $subreddit) AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, subreddit, term
)
GROUP BY time, term
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Distinct authors
panels.description: Different people mentioning the term. Few authors and many mentions usually means spam or one heated thread.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'hour', hour, $__timeInterval(hour)) AS time, term, uniqCombinedMerge(12)(authors) AS authors
    FROM term_hourly
    WHERE NOT ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND $__timeFilter(hour) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(subreddit IN (${subreddit:singlequote}), $subreddit) AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, term
    UNION ALL
    SELECT if(${bucket:sqlstring} = 'week', toDateTime(toMonday(day), 'UTC'), toDateTime(day, 'UTC')) AS time, term, uniqCombinedMerge(12)(authors) AS authors
    FROM term_daily
    WHERE ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(subreddit IN (${subreddit:singlequote}), $subreddit) AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
    GROUP BY time, term
)
ORDER BY time

SELECT t.term AS term, t.subreddit AS subreddit, t.docs AS mentions, t.authors AS authors,
       round(1000 * t.docs / s.docs, 2) AS per_1000
FROM (
    SELECT term, subreddit, sum(docs) AS docs, uniqCombinedMerge(12)(authors) AS authors
    FROM (
    SELECT term, subreddit, sum(docs) AS docs, uniqCombinedMergeState(12)(authors) AS authors
    FROM term_hourly
    WHERE NOT ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND $__timeFilter(hour) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(subreddit IN (${subreddit:singlequote}), $subreddit) AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
    GROUP BY term, subreddit
    UNION ALL
    SELECT term, subreddit, sum(docs) AS docs, uniqCombinedMergeState(12)(authors) AS authors
    FROM term_daily
    WHERE ${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week') AND day >= toDate($__fromTime) AND day <= toDate($__toTime) AND term IN arrayMap(t -> trimBoth(lower(t)), splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring})) AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(subreddit IN (${subreddit:singlequote}), $subreddit) AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
    GROUP BY term, subreddit
    )
    GROUP BY term, subreddit
) AS t
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT subreddit, sum(docs) AS docs
    FROM scope_hourly
    WHERE if(${bucket:sqlstring} IN ('day', 'week'), hour >= toStartOfDay($__fromTime) AND hour < toStartOfDay($__toTime) + INTERVAL 1 DAY, $__timeFilter(hour)) AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(subreddit IN (${subreddit:singlequote}), $subreddit) AND source IN (${source:singlequote})
    GROUP BY subreddit
) AS s USING subreddit
ORDER BY mentions DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Recent mentions
panels.description: Raw text is only kept for 48 hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT created_at AS time, subreddit, source, substring(text, 1, 400) AS text,
       concat('https://www.reddit.com', permalink) AS link
FROM items
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND subreddit IN (SELECT subreddit FROM subreddit_groups WHERE group_name = ${group:sqlstring}) AND $__conditionalAll(subreddit IN (${subreddit:singlequote}), $subreddit) AND source IN (${source:singlequote}) AND arrayExists(t -> position(concat(' ', arrayStringConcat(splitByNonAlpha(lower(text)), ' '), ' '), concat(' ', arrayStringConcat(splitByNonAlpha(lower(t)), ' '), ' ')) > 0, splitByChar(',', ${terms:sqlstring}))
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 100
